verdict.rationale: Postman's own docs say you can 'secure your data with Postman Vault', a first-party feature for keeping sensitive data out of shared collections. That is only a single thin mention, with no detail on how it keeps credentials out of shared files. The community claim that Postman uploads secrets to its servers is general concern rather than a concrete failure of Vault, so it does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: documented masked or secret-type variables, external vault integrations (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault), details on keeping secrets local versus synced, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
